output.title: Well-Maintained 1970s Detached Villa with Garden and Double Garage
output.description:
This detached villa, constructed in the 1970s, offers approximately 200 m² of living space configured into four bedrooms and two bathrooms. The residence presents a stone facade complemented by a front lawn and a private garden that includes mature trees and a patio area. The property is set on private grounds, offering a tranquil naturalistic environment.

The living room features wood paneling and an original stone fireplace, providing a warm and traditional atmosphere while offering views over the garden. Adjacent to this space, a terrace extends the living area outdoors, enhancing opportunities for relaxation and entertainment.

Parking needs are addressed with a double garage, accessible from the front of the property. Additionally, a cellar provides separate storage space within the building. The house's well-maintained condition reflects careful upkeep consistent with the architectural style of Luxembourg residences from its period.

While specific neighborhood amenities are not detailed, the presentation and characteristics of the property suggest a settled residential context appropriate for those seeking established homes with outdoor space and parking facilities.

highlights.text: Detached villa with 200 m² living area
Original stone fireplace in living room
Private garden with mature trees and patio
